name: delete_dataset_without_scope_step_up
description: policies/30-step-up.cedar forbids the delete_dataset tool (the lone step-up canary) without mcp:invoke:high. The engine re-evaluates with the scope added; if the augmented principal would be allowed, the verdict converts to StepUpRequired (not Deny). An mcp-admins caller missing the scope hits exactly that path. Step-up is keyed on the tool NAME, not the risk tier (see golden 17 for a high-risk tool that is NOT step-up-gated).
